newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sets 2nd commercial dlr buy/sell tender.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sets 2nd commercial dlr buy/sell tender.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank announced a second auction in commercial foreign exchange market requiring buy and sell offers from financial institutions, dealers said.
In the first auction, the Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0245 per greenback and did not sell any dollars.
The result of the first auction indicated a drop of 0.1 percent in the real-dollar mini-band.
Dealers expect the Central Bank to sell dollars at 1.0295 per greenback in the second auction, which will confirm the change in the mini-band.
Under the current mini-band, set on Ocober 9, the real was traded between 1.0235 and 1.0285 real to the dollar.
